text:
lex (Designer): quick sync — observed a couple of UX/accessibility problems in the Create API Key modal when orgs have lots of roles. multiselect overflows and the visual "chips" compress into a scrollbar which is confusing.

maya (PM): saw a support thread where a user thought roles attached to their user, not the key. small copy change could fix that: "These roles will be granted to the key" next to the picker.

ravi (Frontend): reproducing: keyboard users can tab into the chips but there is no clear remove target with Enter/Space. arrow navigation also traps when virtualized.

elin (A11y): screen readers announce chips as plain text. we need: 1) an aria-live region announcing "N roles selected" when changed, 2) each remove control labelled "Remove role <name>", and 3) ensure focus moves predictably out of the list.

lex (Designer): proposal: show up to 5 chips inline then a "+N more" button that opens a lightweight dialog with a full list and checkboxes. add the note "These roles apply to this API key." and a subtle info icon linking to best practices.

maya (PM): also recommend stronger inline warning when admin.* or wildcard scopes selected. current yellow copy is too subtle. maybe icon + bold line: "This key grants broad access." with a short expand for details.

ravi (Frontend): implementation notes: condensed chips are css + a button for overflow. overflow dialog should use role=dialog and trap focus. i'll fix the arrow trap by delegating key handling to the list container. will add data-telemetry attributes for overflow_open and create_submit.

elin (A11y): prefer custom disclosure for the warning (so we can `aria-expanded` correctly). check color contrast for banner text at small sizes. make sure the "Show secret" button has an accessible name and `aria-pressed` toggled.

lex (Designer): draft warning copy:
"Warning: This key grants broad access (admin.*). Use only for trusted services. Limit scopes and rotate keys regularly."

maya (PM): good. add a tiny "why this matters" toggle instead of linking to docs so users don't leave the flow.

ravi (Frontend): i'll add tests for focus order and screen-reader announcements. planning branch fix/keys-compact-overflow.

ci-bot: build queued for branch "fix/keys-compact-overflow". running a11y checks.

elin (A11y): checklist before merge:
- role count announced via aria-live
- remove buttons labelled and tabbable
- dialog opens with focus and announces title
- visible focus indicators on chips and controls
- banner contrast meets AA

lex (Designer): action items: ravI implement overflow dialog + telemetry; elin will draft a11y copy; maya will update support messaging and telemetry spec. i'll post mocks later today. :thumbsup:
